response.answer: Innovative trends include simulation-based optimization, metaheuristic algorithms, and integration of Q-learning with meta-heuristics for complex problem-solving. Supply chain optimization and facility location models are increasingly leveraging digital platforms and Industry 4.0 technologies. Experimental platforms are being developed to test and optimize these models in real-time.
